main_text.p: spitalitatis gratiâ sublimasti, tribue, quæsumus, ut ejus precibus & meritis intervenientibus, tam præsens, quàm futurum hospitium, nostræ infirmitati congruum, & tuæ majestati inveniamus acceptum.
main_text.head: DE S. MARIA MAGDALENA.
main_text.l: Per quem mundo lux est orta:
main_text.p: Adeandem: Te quæsumus, gratissimam nobis deposce veniam.
main_text.head: DE S. ANNA, B. MARIÆ VIRGINIS MATRE.

page.notes: Two parallel verse columns; the right column is set beside the left. Signature "Nardi" at lower right. Several words in the verses are faint or damaged; some readings are uncertain, particularly in the margins and at column edges.
